question.text: During vintage/growth years of a fund, value is captured largely in:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 6.2.1.2, fund's value sits largely in RVPI during growth years before harvesting starts. The Trap: DPI comes later; carry/hurdle are fee concepts, not value metrics. Cross-Exam Context: Standard PE/VC life-cycle pattern. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Don't rush to redeem from funds in growth years — RVPI realisation takes time.
